name: Marquis (Marshal Archetype)
body:
These marshals do battle in a different theater altogether, that of the noble court. Trading some of their martial leadership for a silvered tongue and a honeyed word or knife in the back.

Courtly Graces (Ex)

At 1st level, a marquis has already honed some of the skills necessary for court or conspiracy. The marquis gains Skill Focus as a bonus feat in an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma skill of their choice. Additionally, they add Sense Motive to their list of class skills. Marquis ready one fewer aura each day.

Inspire Intrigue (Ex)

At 1st level, a marquis can greatly affect the social bearing of others, as well as provide them with more covert martial guidance.

Instead of the normal effects of inspire action, marquis gain the following abilities, unless otherwise noted.

At 1st level, a marquis may spend a move action to grant a number of allies, equal to their Charisma bonus, the use of their Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier on skills associated with those ability scores in place of their own when dealing with other creatures. This lasts for one hour or until the ally has ceased engaging in conversation with another creature for at least one minute. The marquis also retains the ability to spend a move action to grant a move action to a targeted ally.

At 5th level, a marquis can inspire their allies to take covert action. As a standard action, the marquis chooses a number of allies equal to the marquis’ Intelligence modifier and those allies may make a Sleight of Hand or Stealth check to blend in with a group and prepare to attack. The DC for these checks is 10 + 1/2 the hit dice of the non-ally creature within 60 feet with the most hit dice + the highest Wisdom modifier among non-ally creatures within 60 feet. Any ally who succeeds at these checks gains a +4 bonus on the first attack roll they make before the end of the next round and the targets of these attacks are considered flat-footed.

This ability may only be used prior to regular initiative but can be used in a surprise round.

At 10th level, whenever a marquis uses the 5th level version of this ability, the first attack made by each of their allies after a successful skill check gains a number of sneak attack dice equal to one third the marquis’ class level. If this ability would cause a creature to have more sneak attack dice then their own hit dice, any sneak attack dice above that threshold are forfeit.

At 15th level, whenever a marquis rolls a Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidate check, they may spend a swift action to grant an ally the ability to make a single melee or ranged weapon attack as an immediate action against a creature targeted by one of these skill checks.

At 20th level, whenever a marquis uses the 5th level version of this ability the additional sneak attack dice increase to one half the marquis’ level. The marquis also retains the ability to spend a move action to grant an ally a standard action.

This ability modifies inspire action.

Inspiring Orator (Ex)

At 2nd level, a marquis can speak at great length and with such refinement that it can grant boons or attract the attention of others. As a standard action, a marquis can begin a speech choosing to either fascinate a number of creatures equal to their class level for up to one minute or grant all allies within 60 feet the ability to roll a new saving throw against any mind-affecting effect. Creatures can prevent the fascination effect with a Will save with a DC equal to 10 +1/2 the marquis class level + the marquis Charisma modifier. Once a creature saves against this effect they become immune for 24 hours.

This ability replaces vital inspiration.

Courtly Feats (Ex)

At 8th level and again at 16th level, a marquis may choose to gain a feat which lists Skill Focus or ranks in an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma based skill in its prerequisites in place of a bonus teamwork feat.
